svg.title: The sky answers to the street
svg.text: The sky answers to the street
The system can add agencies and flights without sliding into surveillance, because the people under
it can see it, question it and say no.
A purpose label on every reading, rules
for who sees which layer, a
never-allowed list, and a public vote to
An independent board with resident seats
holds the data. Neighborhood panels say
yes or no to cameras and enforcement.
Local crews fly or carry sensors over
A verified reading obliges an answer
Anyone can see who flew over
shows up here, and so does
Checked by: the agencies (health readings stay advisory, so a refusal doesn't leave a block unmeasured) and operators' data
(ground and hub sensors measure without flying over anyone). Orange dot = CDPH's own use.
